name: name-with-digits
about: A campaign's name carries digits (a year, a radius) that are the advertiser's words, not figures.

output.headline: On November 3, 2026, 2 campaigns spent $219.50 for 5 leads at $43.90 per lead, all from CDL-A 2026 Joliet 75mi.
points: CDL-A 2026 Joliet 75mi spent $153.40 for 8,800 impressions, 120 clicks and 5 leads, at $30.68 per lead and a 1.4% click rate.
Team drivers I-80 spent $66.10 for 3,050 impressions and 30 clicks at a 1.0% click rate, but brought no leads, so it has no cost per lead for the day.
Meta spend for 2026-11 so far is $487.00, with 28 days left in the month.
The 2026-09-28 cohort of 40 leads had 20 converted (50.0%), 12 applied and 5 hired (12.5%). That is ahead of the 2026-09-21 cohort of 38 leads, which had 17 converted (44.7%) and 4 hired (10.5%).
The 2026-10-26 cohort has 12 leads so far, with 9 contacted, 3 converted and 1 applied. It is too young to judge yet.
There are no lead quality figures from recruiter calls for any campaign over the last 14 days.
